title: Sample importable binaural session (925 Hz / Schumann ramp)
intent: importable frequency-waveform sample for Frequency Key Studio
notes: Experimental audio recipe. Use comfortable volume. Use stereo headphones for binaural layers. Results vary. Edit any number in this file and re-render: rgcs-sonic render-file examples/sonic/binaural_session_sample.json --out exports/ (add --duration 30 for a quick preview; the standard shape is regenerated to fit). The beat ramp here runs 10 -> 7.83 -> 4 -> 7.83 Hz over 20 minutes on a 925 Hz + 200 Hz dual carrier. Optional per-layer wobble: add "wobble": {"name": "+-.02% Feathering", "dwell_s": 1.0, "target": "carrier"} to any tone layer — 38 stage-table presets ship (feathering, staged %, octave/odd/Fibonacci, golden-ratio and PHI ramps); list them with the Wobble dropdown in New Session.
